A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements.

raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your field services team is facing challenges with missed handoffs, and we're glad to hear that you're interested in workflow coordination and account reporting.

To better understand your specific needs and integration requirements, we'd like to schedule a discovery meeting. This will help us tailor a solution that fits your operational goals.

Please let us know a convenient time for you, and we'll be happy to coordinate accordingly.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
questions: When would be a convenient time for a discovery meeting?
Are there any specific departments or teams that would be involved in the integration process?
uncertainties: No budget has been approved, so we need to be prepared to discuss cost-effective solutions.
The exact scope of the workflow coordination and account reporting needs is not yet defined.
